permitted_operations: query NCBI SRA metadata by frozen BioProject accession
record child BioProject and SRA Study identities returned by that query
query each returned child BioProject separately
verify union of child-project run sets equals the parent-query run set
forbidden_operations: alter sample inclusion based on biological outcomes
treat parent/child project structure as scientific evidence
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: for each anchor, the parent-query run set is non-empty and is exactly reproduced by the union of the distinct RunInfo BioProject-specific run sets returned by that parent query
fail_rule: no parent-query records, empty child-project identity, or child-run union differs from parent-query run set
